{"id":1926854406,"question_id":4224,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"5 months","timestamp":1771727906,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1926854406/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Find the Score Difference in a Game","memory":"40.8 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int scoreDifference(vector<int>& nums) {\n        int score1 = 0 , score2 = 0;\n\n        bool isfirst = true;\n\n        for(int i =0; i<nums.size() ; i++){\n            if(nums[i] % 2 == 1)\n            {\n                isfirst = !isfirst;\n            }\n            if((i+1) % 6 == 0) isfirst = !isfirst;\n\n            if(isfirst)\n            {\n                score1 += nums[i];\n            }\n            else score2 += nums[i];\n        }\n    return score1 - score2;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"find-the-score-difference-in-a-game","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1729}
